insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only (allopathic and AYUSH)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Aggregate deductible (super top-up) applies before any cover; PED and specific disease 36 months

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity above aggregate deductible. Room rent eligibility per schedule with proportionate deduction if higher room opted

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care + 12 Modern Treatments; robotic surgery capped at Rs 1L except for radical prostatectomy / cardiac / partial nephrectomy / malignancies

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Emergency ground ambulance within India per limit in schedule

room_rent_capping: Per plan eligibility; proportionate deduction for higher room

disease_wise_sub_limits.robotic_surgery: Rs 1,00,000 (except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancies)

notable_exclusions_summary: Super top-up indemnity above chosen aggregate deductible. Pre/post 30/60 days. AYUSH covered up to SI. Maternity not covered.
claim_process_summary: Pre-authorisation via network hospital. Aggregate deductible accumulates across claims in a policy year before cover triggers. Cashless TPA within 1 hour; reimbursement via document submission.
